candidates.suffix: After every state_write, immediately state_read the same key; if the read value differs from the intended value, repeat the same write and read until it matches.
candidates.rationale: Writes often reported success while later reads showed the previous value, so explicit read-back and retry are needed to confirm persistence.

candidates.suffix: Only modify state keys explicitly required by the user's task; do not alter other keys even if they appear to influence persistence.
candidates.rationale: Changing an unrelated key frequently produced a failed final state even when the requested target key was correct.

candidates.suffix: For conditional requests, read the condition first; if it is not met, finish without writes; if it is met, perform the requested write and verify it.
candidates.rationale: Conditional tasks require observing the condition before acting, and unnecessary writes can leave the state wrong.

candidates.suffix: Treat a single write/read mismatch as possibly transient; retry the same intended write before changing strategy or probing with arbitrary values.
candidates.rationale: Agents that over-probed or changed unrelated state consumed turns and ended in wrong states, while repeated same-key writes often succeeded.
